figure_checks.alignment: In both PNGs the arm label and the caption block are centred to the right of the poloidal panel they describe (see finding 1); everything else sits in clear space.
figure_checks.arms_identical: In image-0 the two arms are indistinguishable in every printed number (residual 0.017782, support 314, diverted boundary, gap 7.30 cm) and visually identical, so that comparison is carried by the printed values rather than by a visible difference. That is the run's own claim for this seed and matches the withdrawn-guard state recorded in the run's manifest; it is not recorded as a figure defect.
figure_checks.caption_independence: Neither caption restates a title. Each carries support, boundary class, residual, converged flag and the lower-saddle gap, and now the machine and frame as well. The duplicate content is the numeric readout, which is figure text rather than a table.
figure_checks.endpoints_visible: In both insets both endpoints of the reported distance are inside the frame: the green solved-saddle star and the dark EFIT X-point plus, horizontally adjacent in the main panels and well separated in the insets (about 22 px and 85 px apart respectively at native size).
figure_checks.folded_finding_frame_named: The previous figure review's finding 1 (the in-image caption named neither machine nor frame) is fixed in both attached PNGs: image-0 prints 'DIII-D frame 137' and image-1 prints 'DIII-D frame 146' as the first caption line under each column, in the same dark ink and size as the rest of the block, centred under the panel and clear of the panel ink.
figure_checks.folded_finding_xpoint_visible: The previous figure review's finding 2 (the EFIT X-point plus was the faintest mark on the canvas, thin grey on a dotted grey boundary with its right arm covered by a green contour) is fixed: in both PNGs the plus is now a heavy, near-black cross drawn above the contours, legible at native size in the lower X-point inset and in the main panel, and still shape-distinguished from the green solved-saddle star.
figure_checks.marker_vocabulary: The legend's eight entries match what is drawn: solid green solved flux, dashed grey EFIT flux, dotted grey EFIT boundary, black limiter, filled green triangle solved axis, green solved-saddle star, hollow grey circle EFIT axis, near-black plus EFIT X-point. EFIT and solved nulls differ by shape and weight as well as hue.
figure_checks.rendered_artifact: Both attached PNGs opened with Read at native 1399x720 and inspected directly. No SVG and no other image was opened, rendered or created; every verdict below is about the pixels a reader sees.

rubric.contrast: pass. All text is near-black on white. The EFIT X-point plus is drawn in near-black (#333333) at larger size and above the boundary, so it clears both the white field and the green separatrix leg it crosses; the grey dashed and dotted reference marks read as a lighter second vocabulary without disappearing, and the frame name is as dark as the rest of the caption.
rubric.data_ink: pass. Ink is contour strokes, one wall outline, four null marks per panel and one plus per inset. No fill, no gradient, no painted scatter; the green subject carries the weight and the grey references stay subordinate.
rubric.decoration: pass. Axes are off in every panel (no spines, ticks, tick labels or gridlines); one frameless two-row legend sits in clear white above the panels; white background throughout.
rubric.label_collision: pass. Nothing is clipped: the lowest caption line 'lower saddle gap 7.30 cm' clears the canvas bottom edge, and every caption line is separated from the panel ink and from its neighbours. No label overlaps another label or the data. The offset of the caption block from the panel it annotates is recorded as finding 1; it is a placement weakness, not a collision.
rubric.legibility: pass. Two poloidal panels titled 'base' and 'head', each beside its 'lower X-point zoom' inset. Nested green solved-flux contours, dashed grey EFIT flux, dotted grey EFIT boundary and the black limiter separate cleanly; the filled green axis triangle, the green solved-saddle star and the now near-black EFIT X-point plus are each identifiable at native size. Four caption lines name the frame, support/boundary class, residual/converged and the 7.30 cm lower-saddle gap, all readable at a glance.
rubric.table_form: pass. The panels show a spatial field comparison (contours, wall, null positions) that no table carries; the caption block is text on the figure, not an image of a table.

rubric.data_ink: pass. Contour strokes, the limiter and the null marks only; the inset plus is the single heaviest mark and it earns that weight as the reported distance endpoint.
rubric.decoration: pass. Axes off, no grid, no spines, no background; one frameless legend above the panels.

rubric.table_form: pass. Spatial field comparison, not an image of a table.

findings.summary: The arm label and the four caption lines are centred at figure x=0.25 (0.75 for head), but the poloidal panel is letterboxed inside its 0.28-wide axes rect by equal aspect, so the drawn field is about 245 px wide inside a 392 px box and its centre sits near x=0.16 (0.66 for head) — roughly 130 px left of the annotation. In both attached PNGs 'base'/'head' float above the panel's upper-right corner and the caption block starts under the panel's right third and runs past its right edge into the gutter toward the inset ('support 314; diverted boundary' extends beyond the panel outline), leaving the left half of each panel's width without its label and forcing a reader to infer which column the numbers belong to. Centring the block on the panel's ink (near 0.16 and 0.66) would put it under the panel it describes.
